title: 汇丰编码岗：生产力从20%冲到50%，行政岗会怎样？
speaker: Michael Murray Roberts

segments.en: One thing that you've been really vocal about and I feel like HSBC has been out front with is talking about efficiencies and headcount reductions tied to the deployment of AI. I know you can't talk about any specifics.
segments.zh: 您一直公开谈论效率以及AI部署带来的岗位调整，汇丰在这方面走在前列。我知道您不能谈论具体细节。

segments.en: But do you still see that as the path of travel that you do think that the headcount can continue to come down with the augmentation of AI in certain areas?
segments.zh: 但您是否仍认为这是趋势，在某些领域随着AI的增强，人员数量可以继续下降？

segments.en: You know well going to specific numbers what I do think is it going to make us much more efficient. And we're already seeing the efficiencies for instance in our coding.
segments.zh: 具体数字不谈，但我确实认为它会让我们更高效。例如在编码方面，我们已经看到了效率提升。

segments.en: Which you know initially started out to be 15 20% we're now up to 50% better productivity from our coders now.
segments.zh: 最初是15%到20%，现在我们的编码人员生产力提升了50%。

segments.en: What we need to do is to have all those coders be as efficient so we can just be much better on how we introduce technology and update our technology and sort of I think what it really does it takes
segments.zh: 我们需要让所有编码人员都如此高效，这样我们就能更好地引入和更新技术。我认为它真正做的是承担

segments.en: Administrative tasks that we have to do as a bank and banks are full of administration a lot of policies a lot of procedures. And it makes us just much better at how we
segments.zh: 银行必须处理的行政任务，银行充满行政工作、许多政策和程序。它让我们更好地

segments.en: You know look at those administrative tasks how we go through them and we actually lift up the organization in our impact that we have our efficiencies so I think it's going to be very impactful from that perspective.
segments.zh: 审视这些行政任务，如何处理它们，并提升整个组织的影响力和效率。所以我认为从这方面看，影响将非常大。
